|events=A [[Mandalore the Lesser|gladiator]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]] takes up the title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]]<ref name="Timeline 4">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy|int=Timeline 4: The Empire Changes Strategy}}</ref>

The following events took place '''3667 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]'''.

==Events==
{{Quote|Recent Republic strategic information reports prove that the rise of the Mandalorians was orchestrated by Imperial Intelligence.|Jedi Master Gnost-Dural|audio=OrchestratedByImpIntelligence-Timeline4.flac|<ref name="Timeline 4" />}}
*[[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] sponsors a [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Mandalore the Lesser|gladiator]] in hopes of using him to rally the Mandalorians to the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire's]] side. Eventually, after a string of fixed victories, the [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiator]] is given the ancient title of [[Mandalore (title)/Legends|Mandalore]] by cheering crowds in a Geonosian arena.<ref name="Timeline 4" />

==Battles==
{{Quote|For centuries, Alderaan stood as a beacon of hope in the Republic. But the Empire came, and with one savage strike, brought Alderaan to her knees. Now, time is running out as few are left to face the enemy. For those that remain, there is but one choice. We must fight&mdash;to victory, or death&mdash;for the Republic! [&hellip;] While the sacrifices are heavy, we fight knowing that a single spark of courage can ignite the fires of hope, and restore peace across the galaxy.|Jace Malcom|audio=HopeMonologue-TORHope.flac|<ref name="Hope (cinematic trailer)">{{TORweb|url=info/media/trailers/hope-cinematic-trailer|text="Hope"|int=Hope (cinematic trailer)}}</ref>}}
